description_en: A tapered wedge-shaped woven pouch with zipper end cap and paired leather saddle-rail straps, detached. Canonical front: the broad rounded zipper end cap. Side view: the long tapering wedge and top attachment straps. Rear view: the narrow pointed woven end and lower retention loop. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A tapered wedge-shaped woven pouch with zipper end cap and paired leather saddle-rail straps, detached. Canonical front: the broad rounded zipper end cap. Side view: the long tapering wedge and top attachment straps. Rear view: the narrow pointed woven end and lower retention loop. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Zen: calm minimal ornament and simple proportions. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings and continuous strips; solid wood/bamboo supports and secondary materials only where specified. Keep natural product resting/display orientation. Flexible mats/runners remain thin and flat, without unrequested feet, stands or rigid frames. All interiors empty. CAMERA: straight-on FRONT at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature. Upright products use center-height camera; thin horizontal products rest flat and use a modest downward camera to reveal the woven surface, not an overhead view. No three-quarter azimuth. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
